data.cultural_impact: The name "Shufaiqah" has Arabic origins and can be derived from the verse in the holy Quran where Allah (God) says, "And the stars for crying out (in truth): and there is complete safety and security for you this night in this Mosque." (10:88). This verse is referencing the safety and peace one finds in the company of fellow believers during the early hours of the night from pre-dawn (Fajr pray) to early morning (Sahar), and the shining stars above are an analogy of the righteous and virtuous individuals in the community, who like stars, shine brightly amidst the darkness of ignorance and evil. So "Shufaiqah" can be seen as a name given to someone who embodies this quality of shining brightly and being a beacon of light, guidance, and safety in the community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Shufaiqah" lies in its symbolism of being a source of comfort, security, and protection during times of darkness and uncertainty. In the holy Quran, light is often used as a symbol of guidance, knowledge, and truth, and the shining stars above are an analogy for the righteous individuals throughout history and in the present day. Thus, bearing the name "Shufaiqah" signifies a spiritual calling to strive for inner and outer illumination to be a beacon of light and guidance for others. It's a reminder that even in the darkest moments, one has the potential to shine brightly and bring hope, comfort, and safety to those around them.
